validation: Leave-One-Subject-Out (22 outer folds); threshold selected using grouped inner validation on training subjects only
limitations: This is a research prototype, not a medical or clinical device.
N-back task conditions are workload-demand proxies, not direct measurements of a person’s internal mental state.
The MAUS cohort contains 22 participants and one acquisition protocol; external validation is required.
The subject-independent model shows moderate discrimination and should not be interpreted as a definitive workload meter.
New uploads should match the training protocol: fingertip PPG, 256 Hz, and a 5-minute trial.
